head_commit.message:
Subset Sum smoke: pin darkhipo/subset-sum-mitm@8b105f0 (autoImplicit set per file)

The smoke of 6c06520 (run 41345507330, test issue #96) was not verified: Prologue.lean needs automatic
implicit arguments, and the verifier builds every problem with autoImplicit = false
(docs/convert-layout.md). darkhipo's 8b105f0 (child of 6c06520) adds only 'set_option autoImplicit
true' to 16 Submission modules: one line each, no other change, SubsetSumStatement.lean unchanged, no
.lake files. New tag subset-sum-8b105f0-v1, so the earlier pin cannot reuse a smoke key.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
